statement: Pinned rnconrad device-side emulator attempts to write guest EEPROM contents into eeprom.bin, but its write_eeprom path opens the file with fopen mode rb (read-only) at line 292, attempts an unchecked fwrite at line 313, and unconditionally sends a success ACK for report 0x16 at line 315. This code can acknowledge guest writes it fails to persist; it is neither reliable persistence nor proof of hardware write semantics.

applicability.revision: Historical software emulator; physical hardware variant not established
applicability.scope: wiimote.c lines 287-315 (fopen at 292, fwrite at 313, ACK at 315); conditional storage failure is not surfaced. Do not adopt as a virtualgamepad persistence design or claim disk changes occurred.
